source.name: AllFootball (citing La Gazzetta dello Sport), 'Gazzetta: Inter sign record sleeve sponsorship deal with BBVA worth €8.5 million annually'
source.quote: The main sponsor on the Nike jersey is Betsson, at €30 million per year, while the back sponsor is U-Power, at €5.5 million per year.

note: Four-year deal signed 2023 (Inter announcement); value is a press estimate (Gazzetta dello Sport).
